This 2017 Ford F-150 XLT in Black represents a capable work truck ready to handle your toughest jobs with confidence and reliability.

- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with 6-month prepaid subscription
- SYNC 3 with 8 LCD touchscreen, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with Tow/Haul and Sport modes
- Max Trailer Tow Package with up to 12,200 lbs towing capacity
- FX4 Off-Road Package with electronic locking differential and hill descent control
- Remote Start System
- 10-Way Power Driver and Passenger Seats
- Rear View Camera with Dynamic Hitch Assist
- Pro Trailer Backup Assist
- Leather-Wrapped Steering Wheel
- Chrome Step Bars and Chrome Billet Grille
- Extended Range 36-Gallon Fuel Tank
- Class IV Trailer Hitch Receiver with integrated trailer brake controller
- Heated Front Seats
- Dual front airbags and electronic stability control

Under the hood sits a 3.5L V6 EcoBoost engine paired with a robust 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, delivering the power and efficiency you need for both highway driving and job site work. The 3.5L EcoBoost provides strong performance while the transmission offers multiple drive modes including Tow/Haul to optimize handling when you're pulling heavy loads.

The truck's interior combines comfort with functionality. The SYNC 3 infotainment system features an 8-inch touchscreen with voice activation, allowing you to stay connected through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. XM satellite radio keeps you entertained with a 6-month prepaid subscription included. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and 10-way power-adjustable seats ensure you'll remain comfortable during long workdays.

The Max Trailer Tow Package elevates this F-150's hauling capabilities significantly. With integrated trailer brake control, Pro Trailer Backup Assist, and support for up to 12,200 lbs of towing, this truck is engineered for serious pulling. The auxiliary transmission oil cooler and engine oil cooler keep temperatures in check during demanding tasks. A rear view camera with dynamic hitch assist makes backing up trailers considerably easier.

The FX4 Off-Road Package prepares this F-150 for terrain beyond the blacktop. Electronic locking with a 3.31 axle ratio, hill descent control, and off-road tuned front shocks work together to navigate rough ground. Skid plates protect critical components underneath, while the 4x4 system delivers dependable traction in challenging conditions.

Exterior styling reflects the XLT Chrome Appearance Package with polished chrome accents throughout chrome step bars, chrome door and tailgate handles, chrome billet grille, and 18-inch chrome-like wheels give this truck a refined appearance. The single-tip chrome exhaust completes the look while the extended 36-gallon fuel tank extends your operational range between fill-ups.

This F-150 XLT brings together work-ready capability, modern conveniences, and genuine truck utility. Whether you're managing a job site, towing equipment, or navigating off-road terrain, this truck delivers the performance and features you demand.

The tri-zone automatic climate control maintains comfort for all passengers, while the rear air conditioning ensures those in back enjoy the same comfort as those up front.

The rear Blu-Ray/DVD entertainment system transforms long drives into enjoyable journeys for passengers. Enhanced safety features including lane keep assist, rear cross-traffic alert, and side blind zone alert with lane change alert provide additional confidence on every trip.

Practical features enhance daily usability without compromise. The hands-free power liftgate, roof rack rails, and all-weather cargo mat accommodate your gear with ease. ===== About This 2013 Toyota Tundra CrewMax Limited =====

The 2013 Tundra CrewMax is one of the more spacious and well-appointed full-size trucks of its generation. The CrewMax body style offers the largest rear-seat cabin in the Tundra lineup, making it a genuine family hauler as well as a work truck. At just over 113,000 miles, this unit is well within the sweet spot for a used Tundra these trucks are well-documented to run reliably into the 200,000-mile range with routine maintenance. ===== 2013 Toyota Tundra Performance and Engine =====

==== 5.7-Liter V8 Power ====

Under the hood sits Toyota's legendary 5.7-liter iForce V8 engine, producing 381 horsepower and 401 lb-ft of torque. Paired with a smooth 6-speed automatic transmission with sequential manual mode, this powertrain delivers confident acceleration, strong passing power, and serious towing capability rated up to 10,400 lbs when properly equipped. The 4WD drivetrain makes this Tundra equally at home on the freeway, off the beaten path, or hauling a load through the Sierra Nevada foothills. Whether you're pulling a boat to Millerton Lake or heading up into the mountains, this setup handles it with ease.



===== Toyota Tundra Limited Features and Interior =====

==== CrewMax Cabin and Limited Trim Appointments ====

This 2026 Buick Envista Preferred delivers a balance of efficiency and modern convenience in a compact crossover that's ready for your daily drive. With just 2,041 miles, this Black beauty presents as a recent trade-in with the remainder of the factory warranty backing your investment.

- 8-Way Power Driver Seat Adjuster
- Flat-Bottom Wrapped Steering Wheel
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Front Doors Keyless Open
- 2-Way Power Driver Lumbar Control
- Heated Driver and Front Passenger Seats
- Wireless Apple CarPlay/Wireless Android Auto
- Rear Parking Sensors

- 6-Speaker Premium Audio System with SiriusXM
- Automatic Temperature Control
- Remote Keyless Entry
- Electronic Stability Control
- Auto High-Beam Headlights
- 17" Bright Silver Painted Aluminum Wheels

The ECOTEC 1.2L Turbo engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission delivers practical performance, achieving 28 MPG city and 32 MPG highway. This front-wheel-drive configuration handles well in varied driving conditions while maintaining fuel efficiency. The good brakes and good tires ensure confident stops and reliable traction as you navigate roads with peace of mind.

The Convenience I Package elevates your comfort with heated driver and front passenger seats, a heated steering wheel, and an 8-way power driver seat with 2-way lumbar support. The flat-bottom wrapped steering wheel adds a modern touch, while keyless open on front doors streamlines entry. Inside, you'll appreciate the automatic temperature control, allowing you to set your preferred climate and forget it. The wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps your smartphone's navigation and entertainment seamlessly connected to the 6-speaker audio system with SiriusXM capability.

- 126 Point Inspection
- Roadside Assistance
- Warranty Deductible: $0
- Vehicle History

You must sign up or be a GM Rewards member at the time of the vehicle delivery to earn points, see dealer for details. Get a 1-month trial of OnStar safety services like Automatic Crash Response & Roadside Assistance. Get 165+ channels in the car plus access to 350+ channels on the SiriusXM app.

Safety features stand ready to protect you and your passengers. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags work in concert with an occupant sensing system. Electronic Stability Control and traction control help maintain vehicle control during challenging driving conditions. The rear parking sensors and exterior parking camera provide visibility when reversing, while auto high-beam headlights and delay-off headlights enhance visibility through various lighting scenarios. OnStar emergency communication keeps help within reach when you need it most.

This Envista combines practicality with thoughtful design. Split folding rear seats expand cargo flexibility, while the front center armrest adds convenience for shorter journeys. Tilt and telescoping steering wheel adjustment lets you find your ideal driving position. The exterior parking camera and rear sensors take guesswork out of tight spaces. Whether commuting to work or weekend adventures, this compact crossover responds to your lifestyle needs.

This 2006 Chevrolet Corvette Base delivers classic American sports car performance wrapped in a timeless design that continues to turn heads on every drive.

- Performance Package with upgraded suspension and braking
- Head-Up Display for convenient information access

At just over 55,000 miles, this Corvette has been properly maintained and remains in excellent condition. The striking red exterior paired with the convertible design creates an undeniable presence, whether with the top up for spirited driving or down for open-air cruising. You'll appreciate the attention to detail throughout the cabin, from the leather-wrapped steering wheel to the sport bucket seats trimmed in perforated leather.

The six-speed manual transmission puts control directly in your hands, while the Performance Package ensures responsive handling through upgraded springs, stabilizer bars, and specific shock absorbers tuned for precision driving.

Inside, you'll find modern conveniences that enhance every journey. The automatic temperature control maintains comfort in any season, while the premium ETR AM/FM stereo with six-disc CD changer and MP3 playback keeps your favorite music ready. XM Satellite Radio expands your entertainment options, and the Head-Up Display projects essential information directly into your sightline.

This Corvette combines raw capability with refined details cross-drilled brakes provide strong stopping power, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS ensure confident deceleration, and the limited-slip axle helps put power to the pavement effectively. The power-assisted steering adjusts its response based on vehicle speed, making parking effortless and highway driving composed.

We invite you to inspect this Corvette in person and experience what makes this American icon so compelling to drive. Contact us today to schedule your viewing and take the next step toward ownership.

This 2017 Chevrolet Colorado Work Truck delivers the capability and reliability you need for work and everyday driving, backed by solid engineering and practical features designed for functionality.

- 3.6L V6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- 4-Wheel drive with automatic locking rear differential
- Heavy-duty trailering package with trailer hitch and 7-pin connector
- Chevrolet MyLink radio with 7" diagonal color touch screen
- Remote keyless entry and theft-deterrent system
- Power-adjustable body-color mirrors
- EZ-Lift and lower tailgate
- Electronic automatic cruise control
- Tow/haul mode
- Rear exterior parking camera
- OnStar 4G LTE with built-in Wi-Fi hotspot
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Front bucket seats with power driver seat adjuster

The 3.6L V6 engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission provides dependable performance and efficiency, achieving 17 mpg in the city and 24 mpg on the highway. This combination ensures you have adequate power for hauling while maintaining reasonable fuel economy for daily operations. The 4-wheel drive system with automatic locking rear differential gives you confidence tackling varied terrain and weather conditions throughout the year.

The heavy-duty trailering package is equipped with a trailer hitch and 7-pin connector, making it straightforward to attach and manage towing requirements. The tow/haul mode optimizes transmission and engine performance when you're pulling a load, giving you better control and stability on the road. With these capabilities integrated into the truck's design, you can handle projects and tasks that demand a capable work vehicle.

Inside the cabin, the Chevrolet MyLink system with a 7" color touch screen keeps you connected with intuitive controls and clear visibility. The system integrates with OnStar 4G LTE and built-in Wi-Fi hotspot, ensuring you remain in contact no matter where your work takes you. Electronic automatic cruise control and speed-sensing steering reduce driver fatigue on longer routes, while the rear exterior parking camera assists with maneuvering in tight spaces.

Standard safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS. Electronic stability control and traction control work together to maintain grip and stability, while the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed of tire conditions. These features reflect the vehicle's commitment to protecting you and your passengers.

The gray exterior is complemented by body-color door handles and a matching rear bumper, giving this Work Truck a cohesive, professional appearance. With 59,834 miles on the odometer, this Colorado represents a well-maintained example ready for your next chapter of work and adventure. Contact us today to schedule a test drive and see how this truck can serve your needs.

This 2018 Toyota RAV4 XLE in white delivers the reliable performance and practical versatility that have made this model a trusted choice for families and active drivers.

- Rear backup camera with monitor display
- Blind spot monitor with rear cross traffic alert and lane change assist
- Power liftgate with height adjustment and jam protection
- Roof rails for added cargo capacity
- Entune display audio with 6.1 touchscreen and integrated backup camera
- 6 speakers with AM/FM, CD, MP3, and WMA playback

- SiriusXM all satellite radio with 3-month complimentary trial

The RAV4 XLE comes equipped with a 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive, achieving 23 mpg in the city and 30 mpg on the highway. This powerplant provides the balance of capability and efficiency that makes everyday driving and weekend adventures equally manageable. With 41,220 miles on the odometer, this vehicle represents a well-maintained example of Toyota's commitment to durability.

Inside, the cabin features front bucket seats with a center armrest, a split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space, and a telescoping leather steering wheel with mounted audio controls. The comprehensive technology package centers on the Entune display audio system, offering intuitive control of navigation, phone functions, and entertainment through the 6.1-inch touchscreen interface. SiriusXM satellite radio and HD Radio keep you connected to your preferred content throughout your drive.

Safety remains a priority with dual front airbags, front and rear side airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags providing comprehensive passenger protection. Anti-lock brakes, electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist work together to maintain vehicle control in varying conditions. The four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering enhance both handling and comfort across different road surfaces.

Convenience features include automatic headlights with high-beam assist, front fog lights, heated power mirrors, power windows, and a rear window defroster. The power liftgate with height adjustment makes loading cargo easier, while the roof rails expand your carrying options. A trip computer and outside temperature display keep you informed during your travels.

This RAV4 XLE offers the combination of refined capability, modern technology, and Toyota reliability you're looking for in a versatile family vehicle. We invite you to schedule your test drive and experience firsthand the confidence and comfort this model provides.

A full array of airbags, ABS brakes, and low tire pressure warning system provide comprehensive protection on every journey.

The power driver seat with memory settings lets you adjust to your preferred position instantly. Dual zone automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger ride in comfort.

Technology integration keeps you connected on every journey. SYNC with MyFord Touch provides an intuitive interface for navigation, entertainment, and vehicle controls through the steering wheel-mounted audio buttons. SiriusXM satellite radio expands your listening options far beyond standard FM/AM stations, while the CD player offers additional media choices.

Safety and visibility standards are met with dual front and side impact airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and a rear view camera that makes backing up or parking easier. ABS brakes and brake assist add confidence to your stopping power.

This F-150 Lariat is ready to serve you whether your priorities are hauling, towing, or everyday driving. We invite you to schedule a test drive and feel the difference a well-maintained truck can make in your daily operations.

description:

With nearly 90,000 miles and a comprehensive warranty included, this vehicle offers both proven reliability and peace of mind as you transition to ownership.

- Free 90 Day/3,000 Mile Allstate Limited Warranty
- Heated & Ventilated Front Seats

The remote touch navigation controller makes menu selections straightforward, while the casual-language voice recognition system allows hands-free operation of essential functions. Dual-zone automatic climate control keeps front passengers comfortable regardless of weather, and the split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs.

Safety receives thoughtful attention throughout this vehicle. The Blind Spot Monitoring system alerts you to vehicles in your blind zones, while the Intuitive Parking Assist helps guide you into tight spaces. Four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control provide stability during cornering, and a comprehensive airbag array surrounds all occupants. The backup monitor and Lexus Safety Connect emergency communication system add layers of security and support.

The premium package enhances your daily experience with conveniences like the power-folding heated mirrors, driver memory settings for seat and steering wheel position, and a motorized moonroof that opens with a single touch. Roof rails enable additional carrying capacity for active lifestyles, while the rear armrest storage provides hidden organization for smaller items.

This 2015 RX 350 represents a mature vehicle with established dependability and comprehensive equipment that addresses real ownership priorities. We invite you to schedule a test drive and confirm that this luxury SUV meets your expectations.

Dual-zone automatic climate control ensures everyone rides comfortably, while the split-folding rear seat adapts instantly to your cargo needs.

Safety and handling are engineered throughout this Escape Active. Four-wheel independent suspension works with speed-sensing steering to deliver confident control, while electronic stability and traction control provide assurance in varying conditions. An array of airbags, ABS brakes, and the SYNC 4 911 Assist emergency communication system underscore Ford's commitment to your protection.

This 2026 Ford Escape Active represents modern SUV capability wrapped in an efficient, technology-rich package.
